headline: $100 Best Buy gift cards will be $60 at stores Saturday
summary: Best Buy is offering $100 gift cards for just $60. The one-day-only deal is on Saturday, August 22nd. Available in-store only while supplies last for their 60th anniversary.

headline: Walmart is finally adding Apple Pay and Google Pay
summary: Walmart will soon support Apple Pay and Google Pay. Tap-to-pay launches August 24th at select Walmart and Sam's Club locations. Full US rollout, including gas stations, expected by end of 2026.

headline: Microsoft and Discord subpoenaed over GTA VI gameplay leaks
summary: Take-Two Interactive has subpoenaed Microsoft and Discord. This follows widespread leaks of Grand Theft Auto VI gameplay. The company seeks to identify individuals behind copyright infringement.

headline: Pixel 11 gets in on the digicam trend
summary: The new Pixel 11 phone is embracing the 'digicam trend.' This aims for a softer, more nostalgic photo aesthetic. It's a shift from years of ultra-sharp smartphone photography.

headline: A Classic Scene From the I Spy Books Has Been Recreated in LEGO
summary: A beloved 'I Spy' book scene has been meticulously recreated. The intricate model is built entirely from LEGO bricks. This nostalgic build captivates fans of the classic book series.

headline: Save 50% Off Razer's Premium 14-in-1 USB 4 Docking Station for Gaming Laptops
summary: Razer's 14-in-1 USB 4 Docking Station is now 50% off. This premium dock is designed for gaming laptops. Expand your connectivity with an abundance of USB ports.

headline: Soulslike Game Where You Play as a Sword-Wielding Dog Goes Viral Because, Well, You're a Sword-Wielding Dog
summary: A new Soulslike game, 'Stray Dog: nobody cares,' is going viral. Players embody a sword-wielding stray dog on a rescue mission. Its unique premise is captivating gamers online.

headline: Pokémon TCG Prismatic Evolutions Mini Tins Are Back in Stock at Amazon
summary: Pokémon TCG Prismatic Evolutions Mini Tins are restocked at Amazon. TCGplayer offers potentially cheaper prices and Eeveelution choices. Grab these popular Pokémon card collectibles while available.

headline: Prince Harry and six others face privacy case legal bill of up to £34.5m
summary: Prince Harry and six co-claimants face a massive legal bill. They lost a privacy case against the Daily Mail publisher. An initial £9.54m payment is due within seven days.

headline: Meghan in talks for role in Netflix series The Gentlemen, BBC understands
summary: Meghan Markle is reportedly in talks for a Netflix series role. She may join 'The Gentlemen,' directed by Guy Ritchie. This would be her first major acting role since marrying Prince Harry.

headline: Watch: How 'strongest' El Niño could affect weather around the world
summary: A 'strongest' El Niño is developing in the Pacific Ocean. Experts warn it could be the most powerful in living memory. Learn how this climate phenomenon may impact global weather.

headline: Under-fives and pregnant women told to avoid runny eggs when eating out over salmonella risk
summary: Vulnerable groups advised to avoid runny eggs when dining out. This warning applies to under-fives, pregnant women, and over-65s. The precaution is due to an ongoing salmonella outbreak risk.
